d:
A batting masterclass from Kushal Bhurtel (99 off 51) and Yuvraj Samra (89 off 55) powered Pokhara Avengers to a massive 224/3 against Kathmandu Gorkhas!
Despite fighting knocks from Smit Patel and Rashid Khan, Kathmandu fell short as Pokhara Avengers secured a convincing 55-run victory.
